description.en: Switches the animation/variant played by a loaded image resource, by name.
Handle of the image, from CMND_LOAD_IMAGE.
Name of the animation/variant to play, e.g. "next1".
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Switch a loaded image to its "next1" animation
CMND_SET_IMAGE_ANM(hAnm, "next1");
